stories.title: Health Endpoint Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the /health response contract including status (ok/degraded/down), timestamp, service name, version, and dependency checks (MongoDB connectivity). Establish JSON schema and HTTP status code mapping (200=ok/degraded, 503=down).

stories.title: Core Health Check Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to evaluate system health including app liveness and MongoDB ping using shared utilities. Structure checks as modular components (e.g., db, app) and aggregate into a unified status. Exclude external APIs for low latency and add timeout guards to prevent blocking.

stories.title: Expose /health API Endpoint
stories.description: Add FastAPI route /health in main.py that returns the health contract response, including version sourced from build.txt. Ensure the endpoint is unauthenticated, low-latency, and avoids heavy service initialization or LLM/tool invocation paths.

stories.title: Health Endpoint Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating /health response schema, status codes, and behavior under normal and degraded conditions (e.g., simulated MongoDB failure).

stories.title: Deployment and Readiness Integration
stories.description: Validate /health endpoint compatibility with Azure App Service health checks and CI/CD pipelines. Confirm endpoint is reachable post-deploy, supports readiness/liveness probes, and integrates with pipeline health monitoring utilities.

per_feature.mitigation: Keep checks minimal (app + Mongo ping only) and enforce strict timeouts to avoid latency spikes.
